primitives.name: Historical Ability Model
primitives.verbatim_quote: Equations (quoted exactly as in the paper): - HistAbility: λ_{i,m} = exp(β0 + (ri - rj) + hi·1(team i at home)), identifiability Σiri = 0; weighted likelihood L = Πm P(G_{i,m}=g_{i,m},G_{j,m}=g_{j,m})^{wm}.
primitives.latex: \lambda_{i,m} = \exp(\beta_0 + (r_i - r_j) + h_i \cdot 1(\text{team } i \text{ at home})), \quad \sum_i r_i = 0; \quad L = \prod_m P(G_{i,m}=g_{i,m},G_{j,m}=g_{j,m})^{w_m}
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'λ_{i,m}': 'Expected goals rate for team i against j in match m (dimensionless)', 'β0': 'Baseline log-expected goals rate (dimensionless)', 'r_i': 'Relative ability of team i (dimensionless)', 'r_j': 'Relative ability of team j (dimensionless)', 'h_i': 'Home field advantage for team i (dimensionless)', '1(team i at home)': 'Indicator function (dimensionless)', 'w_m': 'Weight for match m (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Team abilities are stationary, match outcomes follow Poisson process, home advantage is additive.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When team abilities are not identifiable due to insufficient data or zero variance.

primitives.name: Temporal Weighting Function
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Time decay: w_{time,m}(xm) = (1/2)^{xm/1095.75} (half-period 3 years); match-importance weights: 4 (World Cup), 3 (confederation tournament), 2.5 (qualifiers), 1 (friendlies).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'w_{time,m}': 'Temporal weight for match m (dimensionless)', 'x_m': 'Days elapsed since match m (days)', '1095.75': 'Half-life in days (3 years) (days)'}
primitives.assumptions: Match importance decays exponentially with time, and tournament significance is known.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When match age exceeds 3 years or when match importance is unknown.

primitives.name: Bookmaker Odds Adjustment
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Overround removal: quoted_oddsi = oddsi·δ + 1, median δ-margin 16.8%; pi = 1/(exp(li)+1) from averaged log-odds.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'quoted_odds_i': 'Adjusted odds for outcome i (dimensionless)', 'odds_i': 'Original bookmaker odds for outcome i (dimensionless)', 'δ': 'Margin adjustment factor (dimensionless)', 'p_i': 'Probability of outcome i (dimensionless)', 'l_i': 'Log-odds of outcome i (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Bookmaker odds contain overround, logit transformation is valid.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When odds are extremely skewed or when δ is undefined.

reasoning_traces.think:
The core modeling approach combines three distinct learners—LASSO-Poisson, Cforest, and XGBoost—into an ensemble model to predict match outcomes. The HistAbility primitive estimates team strengths based on historical performance, incorporating home advantage and relative skill differences. Time decay adjusts the influence of older matches, ensuring relevance. Overround removal corrects bookmaker odds to reflect true probabilities. These primitives form a kernel of predictive power, where each component contributes to a unified forecast through weighted aggregation. The Skellam distribution bridges expected goals to win/draw/loss probabilities, enabling stochastic tournament simulations. The inverse-simulation ability update iteratively refines team abilities using observed outcomes, improving accuracy. This architecture supports both static analysis and dynamic evolution of team capabilities across time.
